Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: All About Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A meticulous Christmas expert and bestselling author, Adeline Wilson, clashes with a laid-back bookstore owner, Garth Bowman, during her final stop on a lackluster holiday book tour. When a playful bet pits her structured holiday traditions against his spontaneous festive spirit, Adie decides to stay in town to prove her methods. As their rivalry unfolds, unexpected sparks fly, transforming their competition into a heartwarming journey of love, self-discovery, and the true magic of Christmas.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: All About Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A meticulous Christmas expert and bestselling author, Adeline Wilson, clashes with a laid-back bookstore owner, Garth Bowman, during her final stop on a lackluster holiday book tour. When a playful bet pits her structured holiday traditions against his spontaneous festive spirit, Adie decides to stay in town to prove her methods. As their rivalry unfolds, unexpected sparks fly, transforming their competition into a heartwarming journey of love, self-discovery, and the true magic of Christmas.

programme.desc: Hired to protect a small mining town in Utah, gunslinger Clay Blaisedell (Henry Fonda) and his devoted follower, Tom Morgan (Anthony Quinn), partake in numerous liberties afforded by their position of power. While Blaisedell and Morgan match the violence of the outlaws they fight, the local inhabitants desire more peaceful resolutions to the crime problem. When reformed thug Johnny Gannon (Richard Widmark) takes the post of sheriff, he finds himself in competition with the town's hired guns.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición de Nohora Patricia Patiño, su familia descubre el oscuro pasado de su expareja, Nicolás Vélez Villa, ligado a varios feminicidios previos. Aunque conocía su historial, Nohora creyó que había cambiado, pero sufrió extorsión y maltrato. Capturado y condenado a 27 años por desaparición forzada, Nicolás rechazó un preacuerdo para revelar el paradero del cuerpo, prefiriendo cumplir toda su condena.

Aunque conocía su historial, Nohora creyó que había cambiado, pero sufrió extorsión y maltrato. Capturado y condenado a 27 años por desaparición forzada, Nicolás rechazó un preacuerdo para revelar el paradero del cuerpo, prefiriendo cumplir toda su condena.
